predecessors.name: Vijayanagara Empire
predecessors.text: Davangere and Chitradurga districts, with Chitradurga, Mayakonda, Santebennur, Holalkere, Anaji, Jagalur and Budihal

successors.name: Kingdom of Mysore
successors.text: Davangere and Chitradurga districts, with Chitradurga, Mayakonda, Santebennur, Holalkere, Anaji, Jagalur and Budihal

ledger.x: 1588: Obanna Nayaka (Madakari Nayaka I) begins the Chitradurga Nayaka line, a chiefdom of the Vijayanagara feudatory Timmanna of Matti.
1602-1652: Kasturi Rangappa Nayaka I captured Mayakonda, Santebennur, Holalkere, Anaji and Jagalur from neighbouring chiefs.
1779: Hyder Ali captures Chitradurga; Madakari Nayaka V dies in prison at Srirangapatna.
1779: the Nayaka line effectively ends with Madakari Nayaka V.
